note: Type 1 LOOPs page. Recipe: constraintPreset smooth + motionTypeFilter no-dash + mustNotContainLetters [Type 2 set, alpha, beta, gamma] forces pure Type 1 words. Steps captured verbatim from MCP generate_sequence (beat keys mapped to step). Phase 0 findings recorded in the rollout spec: mustContainLetters is a post-hoc filter in loop mode (fails instead of steering); startPlacement may be overridden by loop closure; server still runs pre-fix engine so closure retries may be needed.

mirrored.defaultEntry: DJII (original print example, stays default; its authored prose moves into entry 0 on migration)

candidates.prose: OROT never leaves the four gamma points. The first half rotates everything counter-clockwise, and the mirrored half runs the same letters clockwise. Watch the right hand: it drops into anti only on the T steps.
verified: steps 1-4: every rotation ccw (both hands)
steps 5-8: every rotation cw (both hands)
blue anti on all 8 steps
red pro on all steps except 4 and 8 (T), which are anti
all positions gamma

candidates.prose: In UUUM the hands always rotate opposite ways: left clockwise, right counter-clockwise. The mirrored half flips both at once, so each hand ends up running the other's direction.
verified: every moving step: blue and red rotate opposite directions
steps 1-4: blue cw, red ccw; steps 5-8: blue ccw, red cw
red pro on all 8 steps
blue anti on U steps (1,2,3,5,6,7), pro on M steps (4,8)

candidates.prose: Eight I steps in a row. With a single letter, the mirror is pure direction: left runs clockwise through the first half and counter-clockwise through the second, and right does the reverse.
verified: letter I on all 8 steps
blue cw on steps 1-4, ccw on steps 5-8
red ccw on steps 1-4, cw on steps 5-8
all positions beta

candidates.prose: AAAB keeps both hands matched on every step, so the mirror is easy to read: three pro steps and one anti, clockwise on the way out and counter-clockwise on the way home.
verified: both hands share the same motion type and direction on every step
steps 1-3 and 5-7 (A): pro; steps 4 and 8 (B): anti
steps 1-4 cw, steps 5-8 ccw
all positions alpha

rotated-swapped.defaultEntry: BBLF (original print example, stays default; page currently ties only a bare label to it, so entry-0 prose gets drafted at migration)

candidates.label: Swapped & Rotated
candidates.prose: The same word can close a LOOP more than one way. This IIII repeats with the hands swapped: left takes over right's pro role at the seam, and the positions come back rotated 180°.
verified: letter I on all 8 steps
steps 1-3: blue anti, red pro; steps 5-7: blue pro, red anti (roles exchanged)
second-half positions are the first half's rotated 180°
engine header: LOOP: rotated, swapped

candidates.label: Swapped & Rotated
candidates.prose: In HHHG every rotation is clockwise from start to finish. Nothing flips at the seam; the second half repeats the word rotated 180° with the colors swapped, and the motion carries straight through.
verified: all 8 moving steps cw on both hands
both hands share the same motion type on every step
H steps anti, G steps (4, 8) pro
engine header: LOOP: rotated, swapped

candidates.label: Swapped & Rotated
candidates.prose: FLFL is built from the compound letters F and L, so the hands cross between alpha and beta on every step, all of it counter-clockwise. At the seam the hands trade pro and anti; that trade is the swap.
verified: every moving rotation ccw
word alternates F (beta→alpha) and L (alpha→beta)
steps 1-3: blue pro, red anti; steps 5-7: blue anti, red pro
engine header: LOOP: rotated, swapped

candidates.label: Swapped & Rotated
candidates.prose: EKEJ pairs the compound letters E, K, and J. The hands rotate opposite ways and both flip at the seam, and only the J steps break out of anti.
verified: every moving step: hands rotate opposite directions
steps 1-4: blue ccw, red cw; steps 5-8: blue cw, red ccw
anti on both hands except J steps (4, 8), which are pro
engine header: LOOP: rotated, swapped

mirrored-swapped.defaultEntry: KIEC (original print example, stays default; its authored after-prose moves into entry 0 on migration)

candidates.label: Swapped & Mirrored
candidates.prose: LFLF runs clockwise out and counter-clockwise back, like any mirror. The swap is layered on top: left starts as the pro hand and hands that role to right at the seam.
verified: steps 1-4 cw, steps 5-8 ccw (both hands)
steps 1-3: blue pro, red anti; steps 5-7: blue anti, red pro
word alternates L (alpha→beta) and F (beta→alpha)
engine header: LOOP: mirrored, swapped

candidates.label: Swapped & Mirrored
candidates.prose: Eight B steps, every one anti on both hands. When both hands do the same thing, swapping the colors changes nothing, so the mirror does the visible work: counter-clockwise out, clockwise back.
verified: letter B on all 8 steps, anti on both hands throughout
steps 1-4 ccw, steps 5-8 cw
both hands share direction on every step
engine header: LOOP: mirrored, swapped

candidates.label: Swapped & Mirrored
candidates.prose: This EKEJ never flips direction: left holds counter-clockwise and right holds clockwise for all eight steps. The seam shows in where the letters land, not in the rotation.
verified: blue ccw on all 8 moving steps; red cw on all 8
anti on both hands except J steps (4, 8), which are pro
E steps travel beta→alpha; K and J steps travel alpha→beta
engine header: LOOP: mirrored, swapped

candidates.label: Swapped & Mirrored
candidates.prose: A solid line of C. Left holds counter-clockwise and right holds clockwise the whole way; what trades between the hands is pro and anti, since C is the hybrid letter.
verified: letter C on all 8 steps
blue ccw on all 8 moving steps; red cw on all 8
steps 1-3: blue anti, red pro; steps 4-7: blue pro, red anti; step 8: blue anti, red pro
engine header: LOOP: mirrored, swapped
